title: Sexy Parodius - Happy Coins
description:
The beautiful and shiny coins from Sexy Parodius. They appear in two missions. Since everything tends to be frenetic and chaotic in Parodius, it's very easy to die while trying to accomplish the mission of collecting these shiny, yet deadly coins.

Updated exanimation destination. Changed palette row.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
